Sam (devex): quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today
Jess (docs): did a pass on the quickstart wording, fixed the intro checklist and broken link to the CLI guide (:tada:)
Mike (SDK): merged the Python client patch for streaming tokens, bumped minor version to 0.8.3 — calling out one failing test in CI though
Sam (devex): thanks Mike — do you have a PR link? want to add to release notes
Mike (SDK): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/422 — failing test is `test_stream_chunk_boundary`, looks timing-related on macOS runners
Anya (samples): FYI I updated the sampleflow app to use the new streaming client, demo working locally but samplebot auth is flaky in CI (401 sometimes)
Jess (docs): noted — I'll add a short troubleshooting note under "Local auth for samples" with env var checklist
Sam (devex): blockers: waiting on CI flakey tests and samplebot token issue. Anyone able to triage the macOS timing test today?
Mike (SDK): I can look — probably a sleep/await race. I'll add a nondeterministic guard and push a new commit later today
Anya (samples): I'll re-run the sampleflow CI after Mike's fix and update the sample README with the quickstart command: `redwood sampleflow --local`
CI Bot: build #2387 — tests failed on macos-latest: `test_stream_chunk_boundary` (flaky) — retrying in 5m
Sam (devex): runbook items: (1) Mike to patch test, (2) Anya to re-run samples CI, (3) Jess to add a one-paragraph troubleshooting note. If all green we can cut a docs+sample quickstart patch today.
Jess (docs): planning to PR the troubleshooting note + tiny wording tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/199 — will link to SDK PR once merged
Mike (SDK): pushed quick test guard, PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/422 — added `await asyncio.sleep(0)` and an env flag `REDWOOD_FLAKY_TEST=true` to skip locally if needed
Anya (samples): re-run kicked off, will report back in this thread. If CI still flakey I'll try the `REDWOOD_FLAKY_TEST` flip and then we can revert test guard later
Sam (devex): timeline: aim to cut quickstart patch 1700 PST. If anyone can't hit that ping here. Also anyone available for a 15m demo with the growth team later today?
Jess (docs): I can demo at 1730 PST
Mike (SDK): should be free 1700-1800 PST, will join after pushing fix
Anya (samples): LGTM for 1730 too.
CI Bot: build #2387 retried — all checks passed on linux, macos finished after retry ✅
Sam (devex): awesome — moving blockers -> done for now. Follow-ups: Sam to merge combined release notes draft after all PRs merged, Jess to finish docs PR, Anya to tidy sample README. Thanks! :rocket:
